name: Filter
description: Represents a filter for a single column.
remarks: The Filter object is a member of the Filters collection. The Filters collection contains all the filters in an autofiltered range.
example:
Set w = Worksheets("Crew")
If w.AutoFilterMode Then
 filterIsOn = w.AutoFilter.Filters(1).On
End If

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: On
properties.description: True if the specified filter is on. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Criteria1
properties.description: Returns the first filtered value for the specified column in a filtered range. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Criteria2
properties.description: Returns the second filtered value for the specified column in a filtered range. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Operator
properties.description: Returns an XlAutoFilterOperator value that represents the operator that associates the two criteria applied by the specified filter.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Long.
